summary: promote_family_evidence() in evidence_layout.py only iterated top-level files via src_latest.iterdir(). The completeness gate writes to evidence/latest/families/{family}/completeness-gate-result.json, which is a subdirectory. The iterdir() loop skips directories (f.is_file() check), so subdirectory files were never promoted to workspace/verification/latest/families/{family}/.
